tasks.ask: Write a script app that shows the headline "AWTRIX NG now reads the news from your smart home" on one line. Every word must become readable on the display.

Write a script app. In the left 8 columns it draws a small yellow sun as a filled circle. To the right of the sun it shows the text "Living room 21.5 degrees". The text is longer than the free space: it has to move through that space and must never run over the sun.
Write a script app that shows "21°" exactly in the middle between the left and the right edge of the display.
Write a script app that shows the word "BIG" in the large font. The letters must start in the top row of the display.
Send a pushed app called news with the text "Breaking news from the smart home: the washing machine is done". Every word must become readable on the display.
Send a pushed app called box that uses drawing commands only: a rectangle outline around the whole display, and inside it the text "12:30" starting at column 2, with the top of its letters on row 2.
Send a pushed app called label with the text "This text is far too long for the display". It must never move: whatever does not fit may simply be cut off.
Send a notification with the text "Your washing machine is done, please take the laundry out". It must stay on the display until the whole text has passed by once.
Write a script app that shows "CPU" in gray followed directly by "42%" in green, on one line.
Write a script app that moves the word "GO" smoothly from the right edge to the left edge, again and again, without using any scrolling call.
Write a script app that draws a yellow sun as a filled circle in the left 8 columns and, to the right of it, a progress bar at 64 percent in the bottom row.

Write a script app that shows two lines at the same time, one above the other, and both move: "First line, long enough that it has to move" on top and "Second line, long enough that it has to move" below it.

Write a script app that shows the title "OUTSIDE" standing still in the upper half of the display and, below it, the text "Temperature 21.5 degrees, humidity 40 percent" moving through the lower half.
Send a pushed app called outside that uses a layout: the title "OUTSIDE" in the upper half and the text "Temperature 21.5 degrees, humidity 40 percent" in the lower half, moving.
Send a pushed app called corner that uses drawing commands to light one red pixel in the bottom right corner of the display.
